theorem lg_target {k : ℕ} (n : ℕ) (hk0 : k ≠ 0) : ∃ p, Nat.Prime p ∧ n < p ∧ p ≡ 1 [MOD k] := by
  let m := n + k + 1
  let p := Nat.Prime.exists_prime_between n m
  constructor
  exact p
  exact Nat.Prime.prime_of_exists_prime_between p
  exact Nat.lt_trans n m p
  exact Nat.mod_eq_mod_iff_divides p k p (Nat.Prime.prime_of_exists_prime_between p) (Nat.Prime.prime_of_exists_prime_between p)
